reviewComment.comfortable: Bus was on time and the seats were very comfortable. The AC was perfect and the driver drove smoothly throughout the trip.

reviewComment.decent: The journey was okay overall. Bus departed 15 minutes late but the drop was on time. Seats were reasonably comfortable.

policy.cancellationDesc: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before departure. After that, a cancellation fee applies.

cancellationPoints.0: Cancellation between 24 to 6 hours before departure: 25% of the fare is deducted
cancellationPoints.1: Cancellation less than 6 hours before departure: 50% of the fare is deducted
cancellationPoints.2: No-show or cancellation after departure: no refund

policy.refundDesc: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days to the original payment method.

refundPoints.0: Refund will be initiated automatically after successful cancellation
refundPoints.1: Partial refunds are issued as per the cancellation policy
refundPoints.2: In case of bus cancellation by the operator, 100% refund is provided

policy.rescheduleDesc: Reschedule your trip once without any charges when you plan ahead.

reschedulePoints.0: Free reschedule allowed up to 24 hours before departure
reschedulePoints.1: Rescheduling within 24 hours of departure attracts a 10% fee
reschedulePoints.2: Fare difference, if any, will be charged on the new date

policy.identityDesc: Carry a valid government-issued ID for every passenger at boarding.

identityPoints.0: Accepted IDs: Aadhaar, PAN, Driving License, Passport, or Voter ID
identityPoints.1: Student concession tickets require a valid student ID card
identityPoints.2: Boarding may be refused without a valid identity proof

policy.luggageDesc: Passengers can carry up to 2 bags without any additional charges.

luggagePoints.0: Maximum 15 kg of luggage is allowed in the cabin per passenger
luggagePoints.1: Oversized luggage can be stored in the luggage bay free of cost
luggagePoints.2: Operators are not responsible for cash, jewellery, or valuables kept in luggage
